capex: We started with a small capacity of about 250 metric tons per month of oxygen-free copper rods.
Currently, our copper wire rod plant capacity stands at about 25,000 metric tons per annum, making us one of the larger copper recycling players in western India.
risks: As a disclaimer, I would like to inform all of you that this call may contain forward-looking statements which may involve risks and uncertainties.
While availability is not a challenge, the real differentiation lies in sourcing the right quality at the right price.
focus: With the integration of Sunlite Aluminium Private Limited now completed, I will focus on what this means for us going forward.
We have now moved from being a single metal copper player to a more diversified multi-metal platform.
Overall, financial year '26 has been a transformative year for us, marked by strong standalone performance and our successful transaction to a diversified multi-metal platforms.
